_comment: The control matrix. Each entry ties a framework requirement to the thing
in this repository that implements it and the thing that proves it still
does. JSON rather than YAML so the whole pipeline needs nothing but jq.
'verified_by' must name a policy package or a scanner rule. A control
with no verification is an assertion, and assertions are what auditors

frameworks.hipaa: HIPAA Security Rule, 45 CFR Part 164 Subpart C

controls.name: Unique user identification
controls.intent: Every human action is attributable to one named person, not to a shared account.
verified_by: manual: no IAM users exist outside break-glass

controls.name: Authentication to infrastructure
controls.intent: Access to hosts is short-lived and identity-bound, not a shared key that outlives the person.

controls.name: Administrative ports are not internet-facing
controls.intent: SSH and RDP are reachable only through an identity-aware proxy.

controls.name: Encryption at rest
controls.intent: Stored data is encrypted. HIPAA calls this addressable, which means do it or record why not.

controls.name: Data stores are not reachable from the internet
controls.intent: No database, cache or search node accepts traffic from outside the VPC.
verified_by: runtime: run_drill.sh asserts publicly_accessible is false

controls.name: Audit controls
controls.intent: Activity on systems holding regulated data can be reconstructed after the fact.

controls.name: Workload identity cannot be stolen from a pod
controls.intent: IMDSv2 is required with a single hop, so a compromised container cannot assume the node role.

controls.name: Data backup and recovery is tested
controls.intent: Restores are exercised on a schedule and the recovery time is measured, not assumed.

controls.name: Infrastructure change is reviewed and gated
controls.intent: Infrastructure changes go through review, and policy runs before merge rather than after deploy.
verified_by: ci: the gate fails on any new finding

controls.name: Misconfiguration is detected continuously
controls.intent: Infrastructure is scanned on every change and the result is kept as evidence.

controls.name: Exceptions are owned and expire
controls.intent: An accepted risk has a name and a date against it. An exception with no expiry is a decision nobody revisits.
verified_by: ci: the gate fails on an expired exception
